reviews.text: Everyone was very kind, professional, and compassionate. They took the time to explain everything thoroughly and answer all of my questions. Dr. Chavira even took the time to respond to my additional questions via email, providing detailed explanations that helped me better understand my pet’s health, his recommendations, and the next steps in her care. I truly appreciate the time, patience, and genuine concern shown for my pet’s well-being. It means so much to have a veterinarian who is willing to go the extra mile to make sure pet owners feel informed and comfortable with their decisions. Thank you for taking such great care of Emma Lou!
Very professional service

I had such a wonderful experience at this vet clinic! As a first-time patient, I immediately felt welcomed and comfortable. Everyone was friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. They took the time to really listen to all of my concerns and made me feel heard and understood throughout the entire visit.

I especially appreciated how patient and understanding they were with my crazy Belgian Malinois 😂. They handled him with so much care and professionalism, and I never once felt judged for his personality or energy.

It’s clear that this team genuinely cares about their patients and the people who love them. I’m so happy I found them and would absolutely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a caring, knowledgeable, and trustworthy veterinary team! ❤️🐾
Excellent place, 10 out of 10 because it can't be 100. A comfortable and prestigious place.
Everyone is so friendly and helpful. As first time puppy parents, they were so informative and give us great feedback and recommendation.
Friendly staff.

I asked for prices on the phone to get my kitten spayed they couldn't quote me. Once I was in the office they quoted me $1000 to get her spayed. It was pretty standard, I don't understand why they could tell me that cost over the phone. I wouldn't have gone in at all if I knew they were going to rip me off. It felt like a scam. I am getting her spayed at another location, where they told me the price upfront for $350.

I asked for documentation of her vaccines and blood work for her records 3 times then they gave me an invoice.??  The receptionist gave me sass, saying the results of the lab work didn't have vets notes yet. I asked for her records and given sass for no reason.  I just wanted a printed copy for my folder of my cat's records.

They were very nice and easy to talk to. They let me come into the room while they were examining my cat, they showed me what was going on with his teeth,they talked to my kitty and treated him like a King. Also, they don’t charge an arm and a leg for their procedures. They are fair. Highly recommended.

I've been taking my dog to NDS since she was a puppy (3.5 years).  The website still lists urgent care as an option without an appt.  I was the 1st person there at 0700 to have my dogs paw looked at which was swollen and red and inflamed.  I was immediately told by the lady at the desk that they dont do walk ins.  I told her I was there for an urgent care visit, not a walk in.  She stated that they removed information regarding walk ins, where was I getting my info from.  I told her its on their website. (Pic added)  she said unfortunately they cant see her because they have a "fill in" doctor.  Now, I understand people need days off and fill ins are necessary.  Im not upset about that.  But this lady couldn't care less about animals and her wording made that quite clear.  After this I had her print out my dogs medical record and told her to inform the Dr. that he just lost a pt, to which her reply was- will do!   Sorry doc, we loved it there and your care, but if this is the way things are when your clients have urgent matters, then youre not the place for me.   I hate leaving reviews, because they do no good and im sure yall won't care, but you will no longer be the vet I recommend to family, friends or coworkers!
Very friendly and helpful staff
Exceptional and loving service!!! Family friendly. Love the attention and care they provided to my pet.

I took 2 of my pups for their yearly  checkups and to establish them as new patients. I was very impressed! The office staff were very friendly, professional, and helpful. I loved how the tech treated my pups and how thoroughly she explained everything on my estimate. The doctor was also very professional and personable. I am looking forward to great care for my pups from this wonderful team of professionals.

I took my sick cat to them this morning an they were very kind to me an to my precious as well, I'm very short on money an I'm waiting to see what if anything they will do for my sick cat, stay tuned,I'm back, I just heard from the doctor there an the nurse crystal, now let me say this, I went into there place of business with barely two nickels to rub together an these folks went beyond the call of duty for me an my cat, not only did they see to her every need, crystal called me to tell me a friend help with my precious medication she needed to have to get well, well needless to say I couldn't be any more grateful then I am for what was done for us, just incredible, well that's it, I'm am so glad I went to NDS for her care, now she can get well all because these wonderful folks took care of us, thank you so much, they have a client for life, ok,, it's now been 10 days since I took my cat to NDS Veterinary an let me say, my cats doctor was right when he said she had either heartworm or asthma, it was terrible, I thought she was dying it was so bad coughing an gagging, but he saw her an gave her meds an after 8 days that all stopped thank God, I'm so grateful to him an all his staff, they basically saved her life, I had no money to speak of an those folks went beyond the call of duty with her, God bless u all an thank you so much ,, heaven has a place for you guys...

Excellent vet that sees all of our dogs! I have never had a complaint regarding their care or the staff here. Everyone is warm and welcoming.
Recently our big boy had a nasty cut on his paw and they were able to see him immediately in urgent care as well. Full team was there to welcome him and got him immediately back! We were out and back home just as quick too!

My sweet basset fell sick with Lymphona and had to make the hardest decision of transitioning him over to the other side. This office and the entire staff was super caring and patient through the entire process. They provided a sweet treat tray for my Milo to enjoy his last few minutes of life. I miss him everyday but I am super thankful for this place who helped me through it all.

The staff was so kind and welcoming. They treated my pet with care and compassion, answered all of my questions, and made the whole visit stress-free. Everyone was very nice, and I would definitely recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone looking for excellent care.
Everyone here really cares about giving pets the highest quality care.  They're awesome!

Our 9 year old Miniature Doxie, Bindi Bob, is wonderfully cared for almost 2 years now. She was have some anxiety that we needed to get answers for…..so we took her in yesterday and they observed her for 7 hours and ran some test. Come to find out, she has a really bad UTI and will be on antibiotics for 2 weeks. Some of her anxiety is from pain….but we have been having landscaping done for several weeks…..so therefore she is stressed. We are working through this with the expertise of our wonderful vets and staff. They are truly caring about our baby and her wellbeing. Thank you for all you do. You are appreciated
I love this place! My cat had a dental cleaning done today and prior to his visit they explained the process and the after care and were very attentive and patient.

Pricier than VCA, but I have to give them credit they go above and beyond. My big blind Malamute mix I adopted recently had two negative heartworm tests from the shelter and another vet clinic, only NDS did a test that showed markers for the infant worms. They also ordered a culture for my boy’s eye infection after it didn’t go away for a month just to be sure it wasn’t antibiotic resistant.

So make sure you have pet insurance before you roll up here, but I would trust these guys to nip any problem in the bud before it becomes insurmountable. The pet-side manner from the vets and nurse techs is also great, gentle and patient with my big dumb boy who just loves running into walls and doors for fun.
Very nice front desk employees as well as vet  tech. Vet was helpful and medication helped with Melanie's itching . Thank you all
All of our babies go here and I have always received friendly service
Each time I visit with Pierre Blu, the staff have been very polite, caring, and concerned. I always try to support small businesses, and this is one I support wholeheartedly!

I brought my 14-year-old Pucca she couldn’t stand up. The doctor started treatment, and today—just two days later—she’s able to stand and even take a few steps, which is a huge improvement. Thank you so, so much.
Dr Chavira is Excellent doctor and wonderful staff. The pricing is very affordable, and everything is explained clearly. He provides accurate diagnoses and is very kind to animals. I sincerely thank him from the bottom of my heart for everything he does for our pets.
Always happy to take my cats to NDS. They are very transparent and personable, and the prices are very reasonable! They take great care of my babies
I love that I have no worries when I bring my fur baby to NDS. The staff is always polite and so sweet. Appointment availability is the best as well.

Great veterinary clinic! Coming from California, we needed our fur baby’s vaccines and exam updated. The staff explained everything very clearly and everyone was so welcoming. Thanks for taking care of our baby!

My dog had to have emergency surgery around 3pm in the afternoon. Dr. Chavira could have told us to pick up our pup and take him to a 24 hour emergency vet but instead he cleared his schedule and got our pup into surgery. By the time the surgery was done, the clinic was closed for the day. When we walked in, Dr. Chavira let all his team leave for the day while he stayed and watched over him.  After we picked him up we had to take him to the emergency vet for observation and fluids to ensure no complications from the surgery.  The next day around 6pm at night Dr. Chavira called us to check on our pup.  We felt very cared for and really appreciated that follow up call.  We have used NDS the last couple years for routine care and have always been satisfied, but this was above and beyond what was required  as our vet. Thank you Dr. Chavira for going the extra mile and taking good care of Rain.

The staff at NDS Animal Hospital is excellent and they always take excellent care of our fur babies when we have to take them to the vet. I would definitely recommend NDS Animal Hospital to everyone that has pets! Dr. Chivera is absolutely fantastic!
Staff and Dr was very accommodating and accepting. They saw pet for an urgent care incident. No wait time price is very reasonable! Most definitely will recommend and keep them as a primary vet dr.

We always have a good experience with our NDS team.  From arrival to to departure, our receptionists, vet techs, vet assistants, and doc are always knowledgeable and very  compassionate with the care given to our three dogs. They make vet visits a peaceful experience and provide fair cost. We also appreciate the considerate treatments, always keeping our pets' health a priority, never pushing unnecessary treatments/medications.

Was able to schedule a next day appointment for my dogs vaccines. Front desk staff was professional and polite. Vet and tech were very educational and knowledge. Great experience for a first time visitor.

Firts time at this clinic. The staff and doctor are so compassionate and amazing. I brought my 18yo cat that had not been doing very good for a few weeks. They were upfront with costs and what steps would be necessary to properly diagnose him. When it was time to give me the bad news the vet was very kind and soft spoken. The technician even hugged me while I cried. They supported our end of life decision. I highly recommend them. Pricing is reasonable and labs are done in house.

I will definitely be coming back for my other animals as well.
Had a great experience taking our young cat to get fixed. Booking was easy, the office visit was great and not long. The front desk staff has always been great, friendly and helpful!

Staff is very friendly and patient.  Visit fee is affordable. Dr is honest and not going to charge you for treatment that is not necessary. Did not have to spend an entire day to be seen as a walk in. Thank you NDS for taking great care of my Ginger!
Staff are always friendly and  the hospital is always clean!

My father and I brought our dog in for a checkup regarding some rear problems she's been having. Staff were kind, patient, and very caring.

Everything was prompt and professional, and despite us arriving 30 minutes early, Mitsy at the front desk was able to accommodate us in a room, sort out all the first-time patient paperwork, and get us settled.

The nurse, Savannah, was attentive and enthusiastic, as well as understanding of our situation. She did a stellar job comforting and soothing our dog while Dr. Chavira was performing the checkup.

The vaccination updates we ended up getting were administered promptly and without any issues and the subsequent breakdown of the bill was well laid-out and easy to understand.

I would recommend NDS Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a professional and clean environment and kind veterinary staff.
Great staff. Everyone here is really friendly and great with my pup.

The communication skills of the staff needs deep training, I arrive 5pm on the 24 October waited until 3am next day, because of their policy urgent situation first, my pup surgery $ 5,000 for that amount it sure sound like urgent she was taking back at 3am I was never inform she was hospitalized her visit rollover to the next shift and was call at home at 3pm to pick up my pup, bill is $ 1,000 see what I mean who authorize hospitalized did anyone got my consent NO, the neighbor who's dogs attack violently my pup call the clinic and information was gladly provided ooops clearly a violation of privacy in so many levels.

Love everyone here. They take very good care of us and accommodate my requests for staying with my dog and how to treat him. He used to be so stressed about going to the vet, now it's his favorite time of the month

Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Jennifer! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to continuing to care for your pets whenever you need us! 🐾💙 …

Our Chihuahua was not being to mobile and and didn't  want to come out of her crate. We thought she might have sprained or broken bone while she loves to jump across our couches and ottomans . We took her in they did a full physical exam to determine  if she need xrays . They said that probably  just pulled a muscle.  She was sent home with meds for the next 10 days. The Dr. told us if she worsen to bring her back but he was confident it was just a pulled muscle. We gave her the prescription  when 3 days she was back to her playful  self. We will definitely use this hospital  if needed in the future for our other chihuahuas as well.

Amber, thank you for taking the time to rate us with 5 stars review. We are grateful you felt those stars reflect the quality of service you received from us. We look forward to seeing you again whenever you need us!

If you’re look for a vet that cares this is the right place. From the receptionist at the front desk to the nurses and doctors, the entire staff is welcoming and caring. They gave my pet a thorough exam which hasn’t happened anywhere else from looking at her fur, teeth and ears. I left feeling confident in their diagnosis and recommendations. Thank you for a great experience, professionalism and expertise!!
I got a same day appointment for vet care and was seen right on time. The visit was very affordable and I felt like the Dr took good care of my cat

I have visited only a handful of times -4 times I think- over the past 1 ½ year. Everytime I have had an appointment the staff and doctor have been so very sweet and helpful. I really like the people there.
That being said, I recently asked how much to get a new cat we found spayed and they said they would Email me an estimate. To me, that was a weird answer to a very straight forward question. The next day I received a reply email that gave $822.00 - $962.00 to get the cat spay.
Now, it has been awhile since I have owned a pet and even longer since I had one fixed - probably 15 years since neutering- and at that time it was around $120. But, even with inflation, the fact that this was a female, the state of the economy,  I can not imagine why it costs nearly a GRAND to get one female cat neutered?!!  That's freaking crazy!
With my head spinning on the $800 - $900 price, I thought that maybe I am out of touch with pricing today.
I go on 'Reddit' to see if this is a normal price... an over resounding "No way!" from every person who responded - 63 replies, actually-  so I know I am not over reacting about this price.
I'm left wondering if the doctors there just don't like doing surgery, the assistant who typed the form miscalculated something, or my cat will come home with diamond and ruby sutures?
Other than that the place is nice...
Thank you for the 4-star review, Dan! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pets again soon.

I’ve been going here for over a year & LOVE it. Dr. Galvan is AMAZING, she is very kind, patient, knowledgeable & will answer any questions. I always feel at ease after seeing her knowing she really cares about my little girl.
Misty at the front desk is also AMAZING she is always friendly and helpful & Luna LOVES seeing her.
The vet techs also do a great job!
I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a new vet they treat you very well.

I have 3 dogs that visit the vet too often for different reasons. They love visiting the office & the staff already knows & loves my babies. I love that they care about them. My female dog just had a Vulvoplasty by Dr. Galvan today, & everything went smoothly. Thank you so much for the top care. I will always recommend this clinic.
Thank you Jasmin for your review. Thank you for trusting us — we’re grateful to be part of your pet’s journey!

Dr. Chavira at NDS Animal Hospital is the kind of veterinarian every pet owner hopes to find. He’s honest, compassionate, and truly puts the well-being of your pet first. I appreciate that he clearly explains all options and never recommends unnecessary treatments. His care is not only exceptional but also very affordable, which means you don’t have to choose between quality and cost. It’s rare to find a vet who combines such skill, integrity, and genuine kindness. I’m grateful to have my pets under his care and highly recommend him to anyone looking for trustworthy, high-quality veterinary care.
Lovely staff! My dog felt right at home during her visit! Highly recommend!
Great staff. Always have availability to see our two dogs. The staff are super caring and understanding and explain everything. We love this place and we continue to take our pets here.

Thank you so much for the ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review, Lori! 🌟🐾 We’re so glad to know you had a great experience with us. Your support means the world, and we look forward to continuing to care for your pets with the same compassion and dedication every visit. 💙🐶🐱 …
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Ayana! 🌟 We truly appreciate your support and are so glad to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pets again! …

Thank you for your review, Ed! ⭐ We’re so glad you had a positive experience with us. We’d love to know if there’s anything we can do to make your next visit a full 5-star experience. Your feedback helps us continue to improve!

The staff and provider were able to accommodate me in to bring my pet who was very ill to put to sleep. Everyone was very friendly and caring to my dog Buddy. I will be back for preventive care and vaccines for my other dogs.

Thank you again!

We went to NDS for our two dogs and had a great experience. The staff is very accommodating. One of our dogs is reactive, but we gave them a call ahead of time and they cleared the lobby of other dogs.

A couple of other points:
Mondays are apparently really busy, so try to schedule for other weekdays
Service time took around an hour for general exam, bloodwork, and vaccines
It came out closer to $250 for general exam, bloodwork, vaccines, and 1 mo of flea/tick medicine

If you're in the area, it's a great option!

Had to have sick dog put down. Our vet couldn’t find time. These people made time and were so kind. And didn’t want 400$ as one place did. We were so upset and they were so kind and understanding. Absolutely will be changing to their clinic.

I was impressed with the customer service. I have never experienced such excellent attention. The young lady in the front desk is so polite and has unbelievable communication skills to handle this high volume office. Dr. Chavarria treated my pet, and again never experienced such empathy towards my and/or a pet and her needs. I was rescheduled from my actual treatment plan. However, what was unpredictable was doctor taking the time to reiterate what was best interest for my pet. I am astonished that doctor used appointment slot availability to reiterate what is best interest for my pet, saving me from making emotional decisions.
Nice people
Mary, thank you so much for trusting us. We look forward to continue serving you and providing quality care. Let us know if you ever need anything!
Very attentive techs and docs.

After coming from such a rude vet care place NDS is a huge breath of fresh air. They made my cat feel so cared for and loved. They saw she was nervous and opened a cabinet that had blankets for her to wonder inside of so she can feel a little better. They also were so patient with her. They have so much experience and SHARES helpful tips with you and answers all the questions you have with no pressure or pushiness. We were thinking about adopting a dog and even though it didn't fall through they still were so polite and shared how we took care of cat really well. I love this place so much!

I can’t say enough good things about NDS animal hospital. The staff is incredibly kind and attentive, making sure that both my pets and I felt comfortable throughout the entire visit. The veterinarians are knowledgeable, patient, and take their time to explain everything in detail. They truly care about the well-being of the animals and go above and beyond to provide excellent care. I’m so grateful to have found a place I can trust with my pet's health. Highly recommend to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care!

I had my first visit to this vet to check my cat for a possible UTI, and I’m very impressed. They were able to fit us in on short notice, even though I usually go to another vet. The room was clean and spacious, allowing my cat to roam freely. All the staff was kind and gentle, taking the time to explain every procedure, pricing, and treatment options. The doctor carefully reviewed the ultrasound results, showing that my cat had crystals. She was given antibiotics, a pain pill, and prescription food to help her recover. I’ll definitely be returning!
T.D thank you for allowing us to serve you and your furry friend! We’re here for you anytime! 🐾💙 …

The professionalism and compassion of the staff at NDS is top notch. From helping us through the end of life care of our 16yr old fur baby Lucy to the new puppy exams and vaccinations for our Fiona, we are extremely pleased with the service we get at NDS.
Hands down the greatest vet and people. I took my dog in with an emergency as they were closing on a Saturday and they were the absolute greatest and helped save my puppy. I will forever be grateful.

We are new to the area and needed a vet asap for my sick kitty. I am SO HAPPY to have chosen NDS. It's rare to find a vet where you know with absolute certainty that your pets are in good hands. I knew the second we walked in that this place was special. Shelby is the sweetest and so knowledgeable, she asked amazing questions to get to know my cat! The doctor was incredible also. She was Extremely thorough, extremely straight forward with me (which i really appreciate), and was incredibly kind. We got referrals to a specialist very quickly and i was given estimates before anything was done. I love this place and can't wait to schedule annuals for all three of my pets soon!! Enjoy the pic of my very angry cat haha

Came to this veterinary office yesterday 1/16/25 for my dog Bailey, and absolutely loved it! I came in worried about my dogs skin and eyes; we were able to get her checked in quick. They are also up front with pricing, so there's no surprises at all. As well, the environment was very friendly and nice, so my dog got comfortable very easily. Absolutely love this office, and plan to come here again when I need to for her. Thank you to all the staff there!
Everyone here is PAWSOME!!

Update- we have been using this spot as our main vet office for over a year now. Super helpful and all the staff are kind and thorough. So grateful for you all!

This vet office is one of my favorites and most trusted. I happily take my cat there for care when he's in need and they're so patient and kind and help keep him calm. Grateful for all your wonderful staff!

Very glad we found this place with amazing staff and the doctor who show deep caring and love for the animals!!  My dog is back to being healthy and has healed very well. The antibiotics and other medicine really helped him.  I didn’t get everybody’s name but thank you so very much.

I came in for an urgent care visit for my dog. They were compassionate, concerned and got me in right away without an appointment. They were able to get stat images on my dog a diagnosis in about an hour.
Linda, thank you for taking the time to rate our office and for trusting us with your furry friend.
Maria, thank you for your feedback. We look forward to taking care of your pets needs in the future!
Jackie. Thank you for stopping by and leaving us your rating. It was such a pleasure serving your pet family. We look forward to continue to assist you in the future!
Everyone is very friendly 😄 …

I had a wonderful experience at this vet clinic after my cat injured his leg. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, making both my cat and me feel at ease throughout the treatment process. I appreciated that the prices were reasonable and there was no pressure to purchase extra packages or unnecessary vaccines, which can often happen at other clinics. They genuinely focused on my cat's healing and well-being. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone seeking compassionate and affordable veterinary care!
The website says it's open, it's 7:15 am and it's closed, what a lack of respect for its customers.
I called to see if they had puppy shots. They did but I believe they are very expensive. I couldn't believe it when they told me their prices. But other than that it's a really good place.

I love this office because the doctors and techs are so amazing and caring. The office is clean and aesthetically pleasing, even my dog was staring at the portraits on the wall. The office/examination fee is super reasonable and the vet …
Good start..
Very caring vet office, even the front desk staff are sweet and sympathetic. Thank you guys so much..
Best Animal Hospital in San Antonio.   Staff and Doctors are all so welcoming and patient with their clients.   Has my business for life.
Wonderful first time experience! Was looking for a new vet and I’m so glad I found this one. The place is super cute & clean. The most friendly staff & doctor.
Thank you Emily for taking the time to rate our clinic. We look forward to continuing serving you and your pet in the future!
Very caring staff.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Edward! We appreciate your support!
I prefer taking my dog to this clinic because I trust the staff, and the clinic is well-maintained😊 …
